description: This Java source file defines the class OfbizAmountTransform, a Freemarker transform used for formatting monetary amounts in the OFBiz framework. It extends OfbizNumberTransform and overrides the getWriter method to set specific formatting parameters for amount representation.

classes.name: OfbizAmountTransform
classes.description: A Freemarker transform class for formatting monetary amounts, maintaining backward compatibility and internally calling OfbizNumberTransform with specific formatting arguments.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Overrides the getWriter method to add amount formatting parameters and delegate to the superclass implementation.
